description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Rent dedicated mobile proxy devices for 1, 7 or 30 days (7 where list_stock lists it). Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged. (2) Only after the user approved that charge, call again with confirm: true and that requestId. If the price rose meanwhile the API refuses instead of charging more, and repeating a confirmed requestId returns the same order without charging again. The first call needs country, carrier and days (and optional quantity). Needs a read-write API key, an agent token that may buy, or the order's invoice ID.

carrier.description: Carrier name from list_stock. Required for the preview.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview the charge. Set true, with the preview requestId, only after the user approved that charge.

country.description: Two-letter country code from list_stock. Required for the preview.

days.description: Rental length, 1, 7 or 30 days (7 where list_stock lists it). Required for the preview.

requestId.description: The requestId the preview returned, copied exactly. Use it only with confirm: true.

name: rent_proxy
title: Rent a mobile proxy (spends balance)
